summary: Added an internal EscalateSlot command for Unresolved responsibility requests. It replaces exactly one seat with the next governed responsibility assignment, records escalation depth, reuses Route Revision locks/CAS/audit/Outbox, and rejects a fifth escalation. The next candidate is revalidated for active Human membership, responsibility type, Workspace/Subject scope and limited expiry before fresh decisions are routed.
boundaries: Production routing-policy directory, reviewer qualification and governance assembly remain externally bounded
Capability-correction candidates and broader exception successor orchestration remain open
